primary_targets.title: AI Agent Engineer

conditional_targets.title: Technical AI Consultant
conditions: At least half of the role involves hands-on implementation
The role is not primarily account management or sales
The role includes building, integrating, or deploying AI systems

conditional_targets.title: Solutions Engineer
conditions: The position includes meaningful coding or implementation ownership
The position is not primarily pre-sales
Customer-facing work is secondary to technical delivery

conditional_targets.title: Implementation Engineer
conditions: The role includes software integration, APIs, automation, scripting, or technical configuration
The role is not primarily support or onboarding

conditional_targets.title: Product Engineer
conditions: The role includes substantial software development
The product is technical, data-driven, or AI-enabled

acceptable: Occasional office attendance within Metro Vancouver
excluded: Daily on-site attendance outside the Lower Mainland

acceptable_seniority: Junior when the role provides meaningful AI engineering experience
Lead when the role values broad delivery experience over narrow years-of-title requirements

excluded: Organizations requiring employees to purchase products or leads

acceptable_when: The role is primarily analytics or engineering
Customer interaction helps gather technical requirements
Customer interaction supports implementation or solution design
The role still includes substantial hands-on technical ownership
deprioritize_when: Success is measured mainly through retention or account growth
The role is primarily onboarding, training, or support
The role is primarily pre-sales or demonstrations
Technical work is delegated to another team
The position has little coding, analysis, automation, or systems ownership
